description:
Automated value estimate for a property: a point value plus a range.
    Returns 404 when we hold no valuation for the UPRN — most often because
    the unit has no floor area on record, which the model requires.
    UK only. Free. Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: valuation_estimate
title: Automated valuation estimate
